description: Full edition of SecretSifter for Burp Suite. Adds multi-provider AI Triage (Burp AI, Anthropic, OpenAI) and a Model Context Protocol (MCP) server on 127.0.0.1:8765 for Claude Code integration on top of the same 100+ vendor token rules, entropy scanner, Bulk Scan, and HTML/CSV exports as the BApp Store edition.
author: Hemanth Gorijala
